overall_goal: Cut the chicken into smaller pieces, transfer them to a bowl, and wash hands.

goals.description: Cut the chicken into smaller pieces.
goals.rationale: The person uses a knife and fork to cut large pieces of chicken into smaller pieces and gathers them on the chopping board.

goals.description: Transfer the cut chicken into a bowl.
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly grabs the cut chicken pieces from the chopping board and places them into a bowl.

goals.description: Set aside utensils and wash hands.
goals.rationale: The person places the knife and fork aside, then washes and dries their hands at the sink.
